newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU economic sentiment better in May - survey.
newsitem.headline: EU economic sentiment better in May - survey.

text.p: The economic sentiment indicator improved in all EU member countries for which data were available in May, except in Denmark and Italy, according to a survey published by the European Commission on Tuesday.

"According to the results of business and consumer surveys carried out by the European Commission, the improvement of the climate was due to increasing industrial confidence and higher share prices," it said in a statement.
"Export orders again boosted industrial confidence. The confidence indicators for construction, consumer and retail trade all remained constant," the Commission added.
Data were not available for Greece and Portugal.
